name: Bone Collector
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
setup: Traveller: joins with an alignment chosen by the Storyteller; does not change the base character counts.
wakes: Each night except the first, until the ability is used. Night order: no number on the townsquare scale used by these specs (townsquare gives every Traveller a placeholder 1, and Fabled none); the official app nightsheet places it very early, before the Townsfolk (other nights 10 of 99).
interaction: Shakes head or points to a dead player. If chosen, that player gets HAS ABILITY and the Bone Collector NO ABILITY; the chosen player is not told but may be woken to use the ability that night.
drunk_or_poisoned: The chosen player does not regain their ability, but the once-per-game use is spent.

rulings.text: 'You start knowing' and already-used once-per-game abilities work again until dusk.
If the Bone Collector dies, the regained ability ends.
The chosen player loses the ability at the next dusk.

test_scenarios.name: revive Empath
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bone Collector, Bob dead Empath, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is marked HAS ABILITY, wakes and learns an Empath number; Alice is marked NO ABILITY.

test_scenarios.name: decline
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bone Collector, Bob dead Empath.
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing happens; Alice may use it on a later night.

test_scenarios.name: revived Witch
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bone Collector, Bob dead Witch, Carol Clockmaker.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3: Alice chooses Bob; Bob curses Carol. Day 3: Carol nominates.

test_scenarios.name: ends at dusk
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Bone Collector, Bob dead Butcher.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3: Alice chooses Bob. Executions on day 3 and day 4.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob may nominate again on day 3 only.
